fields.label: Rack No
fields.description: Label-only snapshot of the rack this item was sourced from in Source Warehouse at the time it was set on this row (from Bin.rack_no). Not re-synced automatically if the item's rack later changes.

fields.label: Description
fields.description: Free-text note for this raw material line (e.g. handling instructions) — shown on the printed Work Order.

fields.label: Sub-Assembly BOM(s)
fields.description: Comma-separated list of the sub-assembly BOM(s) this row's material was exploded from, if any. Set automatically when loading materials from a BOM; used to group the raw materials list by sub-assembly on screen and in print. Hidden -- not meant for manual editing.

fields.label: Sub-Assembly Qty Breakdown
fields.description: JSON list of {bom, qty} showing how much of this row's required_qty came from each sub-assembly BOM listed in sub_assembly_boms (or bom:"" for the portion required directly on the top BOM). The row itself stays merged into one stock-consumption line (see _merge_duplicate_rows) -- this field only lets the Work Order UI show each sub-assembly's correct portion instead of lumping shared rows into one ambiguous group. Hidden -- not meant for manual editing.

fields.label: Scrap-Sourced Row
fields.description: Set when this row is the scrap portion split off from another raw-material row by the Scrap Reuse feature (apply_partial_scrap_substitution) -- its material is drawn from the Scrap Warehouse instead of fresh stock. See substitution_group to find the row it was split from.

fields.label: Qty Displaced By Scrap (Original UOM)
fields.description: Cumulative amount of THIS row's original required_qty (in its own UOM) that has been displaced onto scrap-sourced sibling row(s) so far. required_qty + scrap_reused_qty always equals the row's full original requirement, regardless of how many partial scrap substitutions have been applied -- used to enforce Alternative Item.max_substitution_pct across repeated calls. Meaningless (stays 0) on a row where is_scrap_row is set.

fields.label: Substitution Group
fields.description: Shared reference (the original row's own name) linking a raw-material row to the scrap-sourced row(s) split off from it by the Scrap Reuse feature, so reporting/UI can reassemble "how much of this requirement came from scrap vs. fresh stock".
